steps: Lua 5.1 syntax and decoded working/evidence isolation
nativeCI.note: Pipeline source invokes the unchanged 12-case fixture; CI successful, but individual fixture stdout was not inspected.

failureNames: reject unknown-status numeric source even with a claim
reject unknown-status numeric source with confidence zero
reject measured numeric source without claim ancestry
reject modeled numeric source without claim ancestry
reject community-reported numeric source without claim ancestry
passingControls: source status mutation rejected after build

findings.detail: evidenceValue() rejects contradictory values but accepts finite numeric values with status 'unknown' or an unrecognized status; applyWorkingEstimates() labels them COPIED_EVIDENCE and can retain confidence 99 in synthetic fixtures. Numeric presence is not evidence-status validity.
findings.repair: Define supported status/value combinations and reject or quarantine numeric unknown/unrecognized statuses before copied-evidence promotion. Keep genuine proxy/modeled historical sources in their provisional evidence class; do not turn status repair into live EV promotion.

findings.detail: Direct estimator/validator accepts numeric measured/modeled/community-reported source fields with empty sourceClaimIDs and confidence 99 as COPIED_EVIDENCE. compile_itemdb.js validate() separately checks nonempty claim arrays for canonical compiler inputs, so this synthetic direct-estimator failure is not evidence of a bypass through the full compiler.
findings.repair: Validate nonempty and well-formed sourceClaimIDs at the working-estimate API boundary as defense in depth; preserve legitimate source provenance. Reject missing ancestry rather than manufacturing a claim.

caveats: Synthetic fixtures only; no specific current itemdb mapping proven incorrect.
No live EV leakage demonstrated; all tested preview outputs retain economicUse PREVIEW_ONLY and normalizedVerified false.

Same-process WeakMap attestation is intentionally not durable across serialization; separately loaded candidates must be recompiled, and durable schema/attestation remains a coordinator-owned design decision.
New suite is intentionally not added to the pipeline until the completion engineer repairs the failing contract; prior native CI does not execute this new suite.
No independent current-Retail whole-family holdout or in-game verification.

nextTask.acceptance: Independent 11/11 plus prior 12/12 and full pipeline --check; source status/value contract, required sourceClaimIDs, no economic or tooltip leakage; independent validator to retest exact repaired blob.
